document.title: P2 South Business Park - Design Vision and Concept

pages.content: An aerial view of the P2 South Business Park, highlighting the Consultant Scope, Ministry of Culture bridge and welcome hall, and the Ministry of Culture (Contracted) area, with a dashed line indicating the boundary of the Consultant Scope.

An aerial view of a proposed architectural complex in a desert environment, featuring multiple buildings with traditional Najdi-style design elements such as mud-brick construction and distinctive rooflines, interspersed with palm trees and landscaped areas. The text mentions connectivity between above-grade and below-grade assets, including GSM towers and a bridge.
A site plan showing elevation levels (ranging from LVL +656.280 to +657.587), access points (Basement 01, B1, B2, B3), and functional zones like a Service Yard and future commercial offices.

A 3D isometric schematic of a multi-level car park with labeled components (A, B, C, D) and a color-coded legend. It also includes a site plan for the car park at P2 South Business Park, showing access ramps, entry/exit points for B1 and B3, and proximity to King Khalid Road.

Visuals showcasing traditional Najdi architectural elements, including an intricately decorated wooden door with geometric patterns and a series of six architectural design stages illustrating the evolution from simple block massing to detailed facade articulation and courtyard definition.

A site plan showing structural load zones: a 'G+3 Zone' at 107.5 KPA (green) and an 'on Grade Zone' at 50.0 KPA (blue). Additionally, a rendered visualization shows a traditional Najdi-style building complex with central activated courtyards, flat roofs with 'Sharfat' (crenellations), and varying storey heights.

Renderings of interior and exterior design: a luxurious, culturally inspired lobby with Arabic architectural elements, and a landscaped entrance pathway featuring a signpost for the 'Najdi Center' and 'Boulevard Terraces'.

A sustainability section featuring the 'Sustainable Building' logo, targeting LEED BD+C Gold, SITES Gold, and MOSTADAM D+C Gold certifications. It also includes a minimalist black-and-white photograph of a bird on a whitewashed wall.

A section on 'Design Vision' describing the P2 South Commercial offices as a monument to the Najdi architectural spirit, inspired by the adjacent At-Turaif UNESCO heritage site. The imagery shows a narrow, dimly lit alleyway with traditional lanterns.
An image of a narrow alleyway between traditional-style buildings with earth-toned walls, wooden doors, and hanging lanterns.
A close-up architectural photograph of textured columns with directional lighting.
A minimalist architectural photograph of columns and textured walls with high-contrast lighting.

brief.executiveSummary: The document outlines the design concept for the P2 South Business Park, a development deeply rooted in the Najdi architectural heritage of the Diriyah region. The project emphasizes a seamless integration of modern infrastructure (such as multi-level parking and GSM connectivity) with traditional aesthetics, including mud-brick textures, central courtyards, and decorative 'Sharfat' rooflines. The design vision aims to honor the nearby At-Turaif UNESCO site while meeting high international sustainability standards (LEED, SITES, and MOSTADAM Gold).
brief.projectBackground: The P2 South Commercial offices are part of the broader Diriyah Development, designed to serve as a monument to the local Najdi architectural spirit. The project is situated near the At-Turaif UNESCO heritage site, which heavily influences its aesthetic direction.
brief.vision: To reverence and enshrine the local Najdi style of architecture, exalting its inherent beauty and paying tribute to the heritage of the Diriyah region.

Ensure high-level connectivity between above-grade and below-grade assets.
Achieve Gold-level sustainability certifications (LEED, SITES, MOSTADAM).
Create a culturally resonant environment through interior and landscape design.

executive_summary.executiveSummary: The P2 South Business Park is a development located near the At-Turaif UNESCO heritage site, designed to serve as a monument to the Najdi architectural spirit (Page 23). slide_plan.presentationSummary: The P2 South Business Park is a commercial development near the At-Turaif UNESCO heritage site, designed as a monument to Najdi architectural spirit. It integrates modern infrastructure (multi-level parking, GSM towers) with traditional aesthetics (mud-brick, courtyards, Sharfat). The project targets Gold-level sustainability certifications (LEED, SITES, MOSTADAM).
